snippet.title: Resonant Q — Extended Cinematic Trailer | Cosmic Horror Sci-Fi Shooter
snippet.description:
Our seasoned warrior ascends to the biomass plagued Megastructure, where paranormal lurk.

Created by Japan Productions.
Made with Unreal Engine.

This UE5 cinematic short film follows one of our protagonists as he ascends a towering space elevator rising out of the post-apocalyptic slums below. With only finite resources to rely on, he’s forced to ignore much of the biomass infesting the colossal Megastructure — conserving precious ammunition for the horrors that wait even further along the Orbital Ring.

In Resonant Q, players must explore the Mega-Structure step-by-step, hunting dangerous anomalies, scavenging loot, and crafting tools and upgrades that enable deeper progression. Every decision matters because your suit’s shared-energy system powers everything: life-support, scanning, machinery, and special attacks. The more you rely on your abilities, the faster your power — and your safety — drains away.

In cooperative multiplayer, these choices become even more brutal, as teammates must constantly negotiate how to divide and spend the last remaining energy between survival, combat, and exploration. Push further, or extract while you still can.

This cinematic offers a glimpse into that world: a crumbling future where resources are scarce, the unknown is terrifying, and every floor of the Megastructure holds something far worse than the last.

Official Website: https://www.resonantq.com/
